name: linkdash
description: Create and manage tracked short links from your AI agent: shorten URLs, share files and text, split traffic between pages, route visitors by country or device, and read click analytics.

interface.longDescription:
Linkdash is a URL shortener built for people and AI agents. Connect your Linkdash account and ask ChatGPT to:

- Shorten a URL into a tracked link on lida.sh or your own domain
- Share a file or a text snippet as a link, with an optional password, expiry, or opening limit
- Split one link between several pages for an A/B test, with sticky assignment
- Route visitors by country, device, operating system, language, or referrer, for example iPhones to the App Store and Android phones to Google Play
- Read visits, countries, and referrers for any link and variant
- Update, pause, or delete links, and manage custom domains

You sign in with your Linkdash account and approve access on a consent screen. Disconnect ChatGPT at any time under Dashboard → API keys. The Free plan includes 5,000 events a month.
capabilities: Share files and text as links
defaultPrompt: Shorten https://example.com/pricing into a short link
How many visits did my links get this week?
Split a link 50/50 between two landing pages

positive.description: Shorten a URL into a new tracked short link.
positive.prompt: Shorten https://example.com/blog/hello-world into a short link.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one link and replies with its lida.sh short URL, which redirects to https://example.com/blog/hello-world.

positive.description: List existing links filtered by tag.
positive.prompt: Show my short links tagged launch.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's links that carry the launch tag, with each short URL and destination. The test account has two such links: lida.sh/review-launch and lida.sh/review-pricing.

positive.description: Read visit analytics for one link.
positive.prompt: How many visits did lida.sh/review-launch get in the last 30 days, and which countries did they come from?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the visit total for lida.sh/review-launch over the last 30 days and the countries the visits came from.

positive.description: Create an A/B test that splits traffic evenly between two pages.
positive.prompt: Create a short link that splits visitors 50/50 between https://example.com/pricing and https://example.com/pricing-v2.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one link with two variants of equal weight, one per page, and replies with the short URL.

positive.description: Pause a link so it stops redirecting.
positive.expected_behavior: Sets the link's status to paused and confirms it. Visitors to lida.sh/review-launch no longer reach the destination until it is resumed.

negative.description: Unrelated request; no Linkdash tool should be used.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris today?

negative.description: Buying a domain is not supported; Linkdash only connects domains the user already owns.
negative.prompt: Register the domain example-shop.com for me.

negative.description: Unrelated booking request; Linkdash has nothing to do with it, so no Linkdash tool should be used.
negative.prompt: Book a table for two at an Italian restaurant in Rome tonight.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or subscriptions.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create, update, and delete short links, share files and text, A/B test and target links by country or device, read click analytics, and manage custom domains.
